newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on low overseas buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on low overseas buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices fell to 1,142/1,143 rupees per quintal from 1,148/1,149 rupees on low overseas buying as well as higher new crop supplies, dealers said.

Daily new crop arrivals in the Gujarat region has risen to 40,000/42,000 bags (75 kg each). "Technically however the market is now oversold and shortcovering may help prices to bounce back," one dealer said.

June delivery prices were nominally quoted at 1,215/1,220 rupees per quintal but volumes were negligible. Groundnut oil was steady at 342/343 rupees per 10 kg on stray physical support coupled with limited inflows of 60/70 tonnes. Imported palm oil was unchanged at 282/283 rupees per 10 kg. Rajkot spot groundnut oil remained steady at 510/515 rupees per 15 kg.
